data.exact_reserve_text: During 2019 the syndicate released prior year reserves of $15.9m (2018: $110.0m). Specialty lines and cyber & executive risk had releases of $40.4m and $16.1m respectively. Both the specialty lines and cyber & executive risk have been impacted over the past few years by the increased claims seen on their liability books resulting in decreased releases from 2018. Political, accident and contingency provided releases of $12.3m. These releases were offset by strengthening in marine of $6.7m and property of $16.1m. US trucking being the main driver of the marine division's increase, while construction and engineering drove the strengthening in property. The syndicate has since stopped underwriting both of these lines of business. Reinsurance saw reserves strengthen by $30.1m, driven by loss creep on Typhoon Jebi and the Woolsey Fires.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a net prior-year release of $15.9m in 2019, primarily driven by favourable development in specialty lines and cyber & executive risk. These releases were partially offset by adverse reserve movements in marine and property and by a $30.1m strengthening in reinsurance reserves attributable to loss creep on prior catastrophe events (notably Typhoon Jebi and the Woolsey Fires). Overall the net effect was a small release, while several lines and reinsurance were subject to adverse prior-year loss creep.

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' figure was found. The document states a prior year release of $15.9m, but this narrative figure appears to be NET (after reinsurance). A gross PYD figure was not available in the movement notes. The claims development note contains gross development percentages and current gross per-underwriting-year estimates, but not a full multi-row numeric gross triangle to calculate prior-year movement directly. Therefore the reported prior_year_development_gbp_m is the explicit NET prior-year release quoted in the report and is used as a last-resort fallback. LOB mappings were inferred from the syndicate division names; regulatory class names were used verbatim in gross_premium_mix. Amounts are reported in the native currency of the financial statements (USD millions).
